title: Accounts Receivable Officer
description:
Accounts Receivable Officer / Sales Ledger

Doncaster £30,000 - £35,000 per annum (pro rata for part-time hours)

Full-time or part-time considered - flexible working arrangements available

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced Accounts Receivable/Sales Ledger professional to join a well-established and growing organisation based in Doncaster.

This is an opportunity to join a small, collaborative finance team in a role where you can genuinely make a difference. The business is currently investing in its finance and billing systems, making this an interesting time to join and contribute to improving processes, accuracy and overall efficiency.

Working closely with the Accounts Receivable Manager and wider finance team, you will take responsibility for maintaining an accurate sales ledger, ensuring invoices are raised correctly, payments are allocated appropriately and outstanding debt is actively managed.

The Job:
- Preparing and issuing accurate sales invoices and authorised credit notes.
- Maintaining accurate customer accounts, fee records and funding information.
- Allocating incoming payments and investigating unallocated cash and discrepancies.
- Monitoring aged debt and proactively following up outstanding payments.
- Liaising with local authorities, commissioners, funding bodies and internal teams to resolve queries.
- Reconciling customer accounts and supporting sales ledger and bank receipt reconciliations.
- Investigating billing discrepancies, short payments and overdue balances.
- Supporting month-end reporting and maintaining accurate financial records.
- Assisting with the implementation and testing of a new billing system.
- Other ad hoc duties as required.

The Person:
- The success candidate will have have previous experience in accounts receivable, sales ledger, credit control or a similar transactional finance position.
- You need a good understanding of invoicing, cash allocation, reconciliations and aged debt, alongside strong Excel skills and confidence using accounting systems.
- You will be organised, proactive and comfortable investigating issues rather than simply processing transactions.
- You will enjoy working with different people, communicating professionally with external organisations and taking ownership of your workload.

title: Call Centre Agent
description:
Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Doncaster team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Doncaster contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Central Transport Purchasing Administrator
description:
Location: ReFood, Doncaster

REFOOD

Business: The ReFood AD plants operate as integrated recycling units, processing a variety of food wastes to produce biogas, renewable electricity, heat and ReGrow (a nutrient-rich fertiliser for local farms). The plants also recycle the food waste packaging providing an environmentally sustainable solution for all waste producers looking for a safe method of diverting food waste from landfill.

The Position

Applications are invited for a Central Transport Purchasing Administrator based at our Doncaster site. This is a full time, permanent, position working 40 hours per week.

As a Central Transport Purchasing Administrator, your duties and responsibilities will vary on the Company's requirements but will include the following:
- Act as the central administrator for all transport purchase orders across the Doncaster, Widnes and Dagenham sites.
- Raise purchase quotes promptly using the information and supporting documentation provided by the relevant Transport Manager or requester.
- Ensure purchase order information is entered accurately, with particular attention to supplier details, dates, cost centres, values and other required system information.
- Monitor purchase quotes through the internal approval process and follow up with approvers where necessary to prevent avoidable delays.
- Convert approved purchase quotes into purchase orders and issue the completed purchase orders to suppliers.
- Monitor purchase orders through to completion, maintaining accurate and up-to-date records within the internal purchase order system.
- Obtain confirmation from the requester or relevant site contact that goods have been received or services completed before receipting the purchase order within the system for payment.
- Assist the Group Purchasing team and Finance with the investigation and resolution of transport-related purchase order queries, including obtaining missing information from the relevant site.
- Obtain the necessary supplier information, complete new vendor setup forms accurately and submit them to the central team for approval and processing.
- Liaise effectively with Transport Managers, site teams, Group Purchasing, Finance, internal approvers and approved suppliers in relation to purchase order administration.
- Undertake any other reasonable administrative duties as required, commensurate with the level of the role.

The Person
- Strong previous experience within an administrative role.
- Previous experience using a purchase order or purchasing system, including raising, monitoring or receipting purchase orders.
- Able to work independently whilst contributing positively to a wider team across multiple sites.
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accurate data entry.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and Excel, together with the ability to learn and confidently use the company's internal purchase order system.

Salary: Competitive Salary plus Company Benefits

Please note that only shortlisted applicants will be contacted due to the high volume of CV's being received.

title: Commercial Property Paralegal
description:
Commercial Property Paralegal
Location: Doncaster
Salary: £26,000- £30,000

CRA Consulting is delighted to be working with a well-established and growing South Yorkshire law firm in the recruitment of an experienced Commercial Property Paralegal.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a modern, forward-thinking practice that genuinely puts its people first. Rather than focusing on rigid hierarchies or unrealistic billing targets, the firm has built a collaborative culture where teamwork, mutual respect and flexibility are at the heart of everything they do. You'll be joining a close-knit team where everyone works together, supports one another and celebrates success collectively.

The Opportunity
Working alongside experienced commercial property team, you'll play a key role in supporting a varied caseload of commercial property matters. You'll be encouraged to take ownership of your work, develop your technical skills and become an integral part of a friendly and highly supportive team.
A structured onboarding and training programme will ensure you are set up for success from day one, with clear opportunities for long-term career development.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting with a broad range of commercial property transactions
- Preparing legal documentation and correspondence
- Managing files from instruction through to completion under supervision
- Carrying out searches, enquiries and Land Registry applications
- Liaising with clients, agents, lenders and third parties
- Supporting fee earners with high-quality administrative and legal work
- Maintaining excellent client service throughout each transaction

About You
- A minimum of 2 years' experience as a Commercial Property Paralegal or within residential conveyancing
- Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail
- The ability to manage competing priorities in a busy environment
- A proactive and adaptable approach to work
- Strong communication and client care skills
- The ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary with annual salary reviews
- Contributory pension scheme
- Death in service benefit (3x salary)
- Hybrid working and flexibility around personal commitments where appropriate
- Comprehensive induction and ongoing training
- Genuine career progression opportunities
- On-site parking
- Additional birthday leave
- Christmas office closure (without using annual leave)

A Culture That Stands Out
This firm has created an environment where people genuinely enjoy coming to work. Employee wellbeing is a priority, with a culture built around trust, flexibility and inclusivity. Regular team lunches, social events, charity initiatives and seasonal celebrations all contribute to a positive working atmosphere where people feel valued and supported.
If you're looking for a Commercial Property Paralegal opportunity where you'll be recognised for your contribution, supported in your development and become part of a genuinely collaborative team, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Facilities and Utilities Coordinator
company: DB Cargo UK Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Title: Facilities and Utilities Coordinator

Location: Doncaster (with occasional travel to sites across the UK)

Salary: 30,000 - 35,000 per year

Job Type: Full Time, Permanent.

Keeping the UK Freight Network Moving.

At DB Cargo UK, we play a vital role in keeping Britain's industries supplied and connected. From moving steel and aggregates to supporting major infrastructure projects, our people help deliver essential services across the country every day.

We're looking for a National Facilities & Utilities Co-ordinator to join our Facilities Management team. This is an opportunity to support the management of our nationwide property portfolio, helping ensure our depots, offices and operational locations remain safe, compliant, efficient and fit for purpose.

Reporting to the Head of Facilities Management, you'll play a key role in coordinating facilities services, statutory compliance activities, contractor management and utilities administration across the business. You'll also contribute to sustainability initiatives and support the delivery of an effective and resilient workplace environment.

What You'll Be Doing:

As National Facilities & Utilities Co-ordinator, you'll provide day-to-day support across a diverse property and operational estate. Your responsibilities will include:

Facilities Management & Maintenance:
- Coordinating planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and reactive maintenance activities across multiple sites.
- Monitoring service delivery against agreed service levels and ensuring timely completion of works.
- Supporting depot and office teams with facilities-related queries and issue resolution.
- Maintaining accurate asset and maintenance records to support long-term planning.

Compliance & Safety:
- Supporting compliance with statutory requirements including fire safety, water hygiene, electrical testing and environmental regulations.
- Maintaining compliance documentation and records to support audits and inspections.
- Assisting with risk assessments, compliance reviews and corrective action tracking.

Contractor & Supplier Management:
- Acting as a key contact for facilities and utilities contractors.
- Ensuring contractors comply with DB Cargo UK's safety and site access requirements.
- Raising purchase orders, monitoring contractor performance and validating completed works.

Utilities Management:
- Coordinating utilities activities across the national property portfolio.
- Working with suppliers, tenants, stakeholders and energy partners to ensure efficient utilities administration.
- Supporting new connections, disconnections, meter installations and change-of-tenancy activities.
- Maintaining utilities consumption data and supporting budget forecasting and reporting.
- Assisting with sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.

Property & Business Support:
- Supporting workspace planning and operational property requirements across depots and offices.
- Producing reports, dashboards and KPI updates for management review.
- Assisting with facilities budgets, service charge administration and expenditure tracking.
- Building effective relationships with operational, engineering and safety teams across the business.

What We're Looking For:

We're looking for an organised and proactive individual with facilities management experience and a strong customer-focused approach.

Essential:
- Experience within a facilities management support, property administration or facilities coordination role.
- Good understanding of maintenance management, contractor coordination and FM compliance requirements.
- Experience working with utilities processes, supplier relationships, meter data or energy administration.
- Strong organisational and prioritisation skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Competent user of Microsoft Office, CAFM systems and reporting tools.
- Willingness to travel occasionally to DB Cargo UK sites nationwide.

Desirable:
- IWFM Level 3 qualification or willingness to work towards one.
- Experience within rail, logistics, industrial or other safety-critical environments.
- Knowledge of utilities budgeting, asset management and sustainability initiatives.
- Understanding of CDM Regulations and project coordination.
- Awareness of IOSH or NEBOSH principles relevant to facilities operations.

What You'll Bring:

You'll be someone who:
- Takes ownership and works proactively to resolve issues.
- Has strong attention to detail and a commitment to high standards.
- Places safety at the centre of everything they do.
- Builds positive relationships with colleagues, suppliers and stakeholders.
- Works collaboratively while remaining confident in managing priorities independently.
- Adapts well in a fast-paced operational environment.

Our Commitment to Inclusion:

DB Cargo UK is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment process. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the application process, please let us know.

Ready to Apply?

If you're looking to develop your career within facilities and utilities management while supporting one of the UK's leading rail freight operators, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and help keep DB Cargo UK's property and infrastructure network operating safely, efficiently and sustainably.

Please click APPLY to send your CV for this role.

Candidates with experience of: Facilities Coordinator, Facilities Management Coordinator, Facilities Officer, Facilities Manager, Facilities Operations Coordinator, Facilities Support Officer, may also be considered for this role.

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Our client is a well-established and successful manufacturer. They are looking for a Logistics Coordinator to co-ordinate new equipment projects for national and international shipping to customers.

Salary: £15.00 per hour + Overtime

NOTE: This is a temporary contract for 3 to 6 months (there may be a chance to go permanent, but not guaranteed)

PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU MEET THE MAJORITY OF THE FOLLOWING REQUIREMENTS:
- A minimum of 3 years Logistics experience is essential, along with some experience in Supply Chain.
- You have experience of using a Counterbalance FLT, and have an in-date Counterbalance Forklift Truck license.
- You are fully conversant with Microsoft applications, particularly Dynamics 365, OneNote and Excel.
- Flexibility to work within a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
- Great communication skills, especially with teamwork.
- Time management, organisation, and prioritising skills.

Responsibilities:

The role will involve the aftermarket sales shipment handling with the Aftermarket Sales Co-Ordinator for preparation, documentation and transactional requirements in the system. The Logistics Co-ordinator role encompasses all elements of customer shipments including internal discussions, product expediting, supplier co-ordination for packing and loading, consumable management, all required documentation and organisation/communication with shipping agents. In parallel with general tasks, there is also a necessity to be involved with improvement projects for the Supply Chain team and Logistics functions.
- Facilitate the shipping of projects from one destination to another.
- Co-ordinating and taking part in the loading of shipments with fork lift truck drivers.
- Load preparation with Forklift Truck Drivers.
- Operate a Counterbalance Fork Lift Truck (with fork extensions).
- Orchestrate deliveries to meet customer demand to an internal on time in full delivery target.
- Liaising and management of packing and crating requirements, internal and external communication.
- Organising shipment collections.
- Internal communications for shipment of projects such as Production, Finance and any other department supporting the shipping process.
- Administrative requirements in the system including photographs and the use of Infor XA, OneNote and Microsoft applications (e.g. Excel and Dynamics 365).
- Creation and maintenance of project folders for Logistics information.
- Storage of projects prior to shipment and optimisation of space/capacity.
- Consumable management for Logistics requirements.
- New equipment identification tagging and checks.
- Creation of documents for use on project content checks and shipment inclusive of packing lists and commercial invoice.
- Take steps to avoid additional shipment of project content (i.e. missed items in the original shipment).
- Documenting shipment information such as photographs and paperwork per project.
- Volumetric analysis and expectations for shipment requirements i.e. container volume per project.
- Process reviews to streamline the shipping and transportation processes.
- Documentation and customer communication for Aftermarket sales orders.
- Shipment bookings for Aftermarket sales orders.
- Checks and compliance to the required country legislation for all documentation projects and Aftermarket sales orders.
- Purchase orders and transactions within Infor XA and AS400 in a timely manner for projects and Aftermarket sales orders.
- Any other task that is required to fulfil the duties within the Logistics and Supply Chain function.

This role would suit someone with experience in a similar role, such as; Logistics Planner / Dispatch Planner / Despatch Coordinator / Supply Chain Coordinator / Operations Coordinator / Transport Coordinator / Operations Scheduler / Logistics Specialist / Shipping Clerk / Export Coordinator / Shipping Coordinator / Fleet Coordinator / Logistics Supervisor / Logistics Manager / Export Coordinator

title: Payroll Officer
company: Beyond Talent Solutions Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Payroll Officer

Location: Doncaster

Salary: 32,000 - 35,000 per annum, dependent on experience

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent - Hybrid working available

Beyond Talent Solutions are currently recruiting for an experienced Payroll Officer to join a busy and growing team based in Doncaster.

This is an excellent opportunity for a knowledgeable payroll professional who has experience managing the full end-to-end payroll process and can confidently take ownership of payroll from start to finish.

The successful candidate will have strong payroll knowledge, excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple payroll deadlines whilst ensuring accuracy and compliance at all times.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage the full end-to-end payroll process, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time.
- Process monthly payroll from start to finish, including starters, leavers, contractual changes and salary adjustments.
- Calculate and process statutory payments, including SSP, SMP, SPP and other statutory deductions.
- Process holiday pay, overtime, bonuses, commission and other payroll adjustments.
- Ensure PAYE, National Insurance, pension contributions and other deductions are calculated correctly.
- Manage pension submissions and liaise with pension providers.
- Complete payroll reconciliations and investigate any discrepancies.
- Ensure accurate and timely submission of RTI reports to HMRC.
- Respond to payroll queries from employees and management in a professional and timely manner.
- Maintain accurate payroll records and ensure compliance with current legislation and HMRC requirements.
- Assist with payroll reporting, audits and year-end processes, including P60s and P11 Ds where applicable.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:
- Proven experience in a payroll position, with responsibility for the full end-to-end payroll process.
- Strong knowledge of payroll legislation, PAYE, National Insurance and statutory payments.
- Experience processing payroll accurately and to strict deadlines.
- Good working knowledge of pension contributions and auto-enrolment.
- Excellent attention to detail and strong numerical skills.
- The ability to work independently and manage your own workload.
- Strong communication and organisational skills.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and resolving payroll queries.

If you have strong end-to-end payroll experience and are looking for a new permanent opportunity in the Doncaster area, we would love to hear from you. Get in touch with Nicole Linacre or Hannah Guy!
